evidence: Row 43 has no demonstrated scoring-policy defect. The actual workbook Quality Checks row 44 requires zero reward and no scored suite after gate failure, no gate reward mass, and a functional floor; its Internal Quality Checks annotation says gate failure hard-zeros quality terms and cheap gates alone earn little. Frozen task tests/scoring.toml:1-11 is byte-identical to the frozen template: gates render=constraints=0.0; scored weights functional=.6, polish=.2, visual=.2; functional floor=.05. The gate judge criteria are binary with all_pass (both gates/*/judge.toml:14-21); their internal criterion weight1 only aggregates the binary gate and contributes no final reward mass. Unchanged score.py:40-48 requires all gates>0, suppresses scored values when a gate fails, weights only the three scored dimensions, and hard-zeros unless functional>.05. score.py:83 returns1 on gate failure. test.sh:212-227 deletes stale scored output, runs gates first, invokes score.py, exits on status1, and reaches scored only on status0. The task scoring.toml, score.py and test.sh are byte-identical to the frozen template (SHA256 95f70d6e06aae5e765b2309d88c444aa36d4cd82763ea2212781b6a99311bbba, 13de2b3885967e22aa13ded3bf33c354e3e741e85be871612c04e996eef5c04e, bd68259276ca4b034654efc8a1723a4e702ed62dbe590af6201565f43eabe5aa). I executed the unchanged frozen scorer with Python -B over nine synthetic dimension vectors; evidence/43/score-results.json records commands, exit codes and actual rewards. Each gate failure with perfect supplied scored values returns1/reward0, zeros scored values and marks them skipped. Gates alone earn0. Functional0 and .05 with polish=visual=1 earn0; .0501 earns.4301; (.5,.5,.5) earns.5; all1 earns1. These are scorer measurements, not app grades. Broken-app challenge: a pretty no-op requisition save is rejected by constraints/judge.toml:23-25 because the independent signed-in context must retrieve both the newly created requisition and PENDING offer. Hash-verified local/gate-witness/results.json confirms no_op_create returned HTTP200 but saved neither record and failed its scripted prerequisite witness. A dead-approval variant still passed that basic intake witness, as expressly intended by constraints:25; later economics remain scored. It is a partial working app, and this script did not measure its total reward. Conforming alternative challenge: a working initially empty app with generated IDs, different layout/routes, and no separate title/department field is expressly accepted by instruction.md and constraints:23-25; no contrary extra gate demand was found. Hash verification is recorded in evidence/43/verification.json: all four cited indexed raw artifacts matched, and all15 test hashes in configured-inspection/results.json matched frozen files. Runtime limit remains material: current raw index explicitly states full configured grading/workload and empirical app reward discrimination/ranking are absent. The gate witness proves finite scripted observations, and configured-inspection labels itself parser/CLI construction only. The end-to-end configured shell/judge rejection of adversarial apps, configured duration, Oracle and target scores are not established. Thus Note/risk=true preserves the required missing-runtime evidence without alleging or modifying shared policy.
suggested_fix: Retain canonical scoring and harness bytes. When authorized credentials/runs are available, attach current-input hash-bound full configured grading and adversarial/partial-app reward evidence; do not treat these synthetic vectors or scripted browser witnesses as that measurement.
